quoteAsset.note: Configured as Binance-Peg BSC-USD, 18 decimals. Player-facing UI should call it BSC-USD or clearly identify the bridged token.

blockers: Mainnet RPC, deployer key file, operations treasury, VRF subscription ID, callback gas limit, initial BSC-USD liquidity, and minimum pool value must be supplied in the deployment shell.
The deployer must own a funded native-payment VRF v2.5 subscription. The read-only preflight has not been run against the owner's mainnet RPC and subscription.
The purchase contract flow is buyBoxes (ERC-20 allowance plus purchase) or buyBoxesWithBNB. Plain BSC-USD transfers do not mint a box; player-facing purchase UX must match the contract call.
Production keeper/API/database hosting and monitoring are not provisioned. The hourly keeper must mature the 24-hour TWAP before sales can open.
The public player HTML still hard-codes BSC Testnet (Chain ID 97) addresses and labels; it must be switched to generated mainnet addresses and wallet transaction flows after deployment.
The mainnet contracts have not been independently audited, and no mainnet deployment has been sent.
